newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values edge lower.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat values edge lower.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soft red winter wheat basis values were lower for January and February positions in reaction to light demand, while values for corn, soybeans and hard red winter wheat were unchanged, grain dealers said.
Sri Lanka is scheduled to tender January 3 for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin soft and hard wheat for January and February shipment.
The Commodity Credit Corp was scheduled to tender January 7 for up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. Shipment was for January 25-February 20.
Export demand for corn and soybeans was light.
